provenance.prompt: Revise the supplied rejected four-pose Kraken block sprite sheet into production-ready game sprites, using the supplied Kraken locomotion atlas as the exact character design and exact crisp pixel-art rendering reference. Preserve the action sequence and same character: four original right-facing full-body frames in a strict 2-column by 2-row row-major grid. Make each figure smaller and centered well inside its equal-size cell, with a wide transparent gutter between rows and columns, at least 12% transparent padding from every cell edge, and no hand, ear, hair or shoe closer than 12% to an edge. Keep all anatomy complete, no clipping. Align grounded poses to the same baseline. Use the reference's compact 80x96 game-sprite pixel density, sharp stepped outline, clean pixel clusters and restrained shading. Keep the adult male elf-like identity, natural skin tone, short cropped dark hair, pointed ears, refined face, burgundy/dark gothic Vesper Harbor kit with copper accents and copper Cthulhu amulet. No tentacles, sea-creature features or blue skin. Four distinct poses: defensive crouch, takeoff with near hand rising, apex block with open hand vertically extended and knees folded, balanced landing recoil. Hands remain empty; no basketball is drawn. Preserve true transparent background; do not include floor, shadows, court, hoop, glow, backdrop, grid lines, text, logo, border, extra objects, merged silhouettes, duplicate poses, or extra limbs. Keep the four pose figures consistent and match the production atlas pixel art rather than the smoother shading of the rejected sheet.
